editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Bullwaves scores 4.2 out of 10 from NAFT in May 2026. A new offshore broker (launched 2023) with only FSA Seychelles regulation and less than three years of operating history. The commission-free ECN pricing model is genuinely unusual and potentially attractive, but the lack of any Tier-1 licence, a Trustpilot profile warning for suspected fake reviews, website quality issues flagged by independent reviewers, and minimal public withdrawal evidence make this a high-risk choice. Not a confirmed scam — but not a broker NAFT can recommend with confidence at this stage of its lifecycle.
